body:
📦 **Blocksail `7d0b233a3`** — Strip yard-hull twins from shipyards and update Blockside battle bundle

Refs TASK-1350

- tools/townmodels.py: detect and export yard-hull twin parts, exclude
  yard-hull voxels before voxelizing/downsampling/townrise in act_build so
  slipway rails/pilings remain intact and idle shipyards show no static hull,
  add selective model filtering to act_build, and guard townkit_flaw.json reads
  with fallback to HEAD on JSON syntax error.
- Rebuild world/townkit/common-shipyard-{small,large,small-water,large-water}.js
  and world/townkit/index.js (plus local townmesh .bin rebuild).
- Bump external/Blockside submodule and rebuild battle.html (5.60 MB).

👥 參與者：@ridge-001

---
